main_measure.name: OLS slope t of excess 20-bar return on forecast, pooled non-overlapping cases
main_measure.threshold: confirm: slope > 0 with t >= 2.0 and top-minus-bottom fifth > 0; reject: slope < 0 with t <= -2.0; otherwise inconclusive; at least 200 cases and 40 in the top fifth

supporting_check.name: mean excess 20-bar return, top fifth minus bottom fifth of forecast

decided_by: Inconclusive rule: the slope t is between -2.0 and 2.0.
reading: Fifths are cut at the pooled 20th and 80th percentiles of the cases' forecasts (top: forecast >= 80th percentile, bottom: <= 20th, ties included), cases are the bars at positions 0, 20, 40, ... of each window with the 20-bar return inside the window, and the coin's mean 20-bar return is taken over these grid cases of all its windows.
